options: Copy a script to the SD card
The lua start command in MAVProxy
questions.explain: After a reboot the rest of the SCR_ parameters appear.

questions.q: Where do scripts live on the flight controller?
options: In the root of the SD card
Inside the firmware, in the ROMFS section
questions.explain: In SITL — the scripts folder in the directory the simulator was launched from.

options: Itself and a delay in ms
questions.explain: The function and the delay until the next call: the scheduler calls it again on its own — no infinite loops.

questions.q: If one script exhausts the memory…
questions.explain: All scripts stop until a reboot — hence the importance of SCR_HEAP_SIZE and careful coding.

questions.q: Why don't scripts using SIM_* end up on a real aircraft?
options: A real FC has no SIM_*
questions.explain: SIM_* exists only in the simulator.

questions.q: What does the update() function return in ArduPilot Lua?
options: update and a delay in ms
A boolean true/false and an error code

questions.q: What the motor_failure_test.lua applet is for:
questions.explain: Stops motors per a bitmask (MOT_STOP_BITMASK) with an RCx_OPTION 300 switch to test a failure.
